g.title: S-03-light — Service Definition (light)
g.desc: ?view=definition&version=v12 · declaration separated from deployment and observation: purpose, entry_point, aliased component refs, component-level vs service-level publication subject semantics, principal + Policy context, metadata, relationships, versions, raw typed spec closed by default behind a ▸ disclosure with Copy YAML; no credentials or secret values

g.text: card_service_01 · apiVersion wyrd/v1 · owner j.reyes · Customer-facing checkout: capture, hold and decline decisions for every cart.
Customer-facing checkout: capture, hold and decline decisions for every cart.
acme.checkout.app:app — imported by the deploy image, never by Wyrd
derived from card_ref · bound on first deploy contact (no service_account field)
aliases are runtime names; each ref keeps its own Card
capture_prompt and shared_prompt are two authored aliases resolving to one Card — distinct occurrences, one identity.
publishes_to targets resolve to Eval or Drift only
component-level — components[].publishes_to · subject is the component's Card, observed through checkout-api v12
ranker (Model v12) → model-drift (Drift v3) · checkout-agent (Agent v6) → checkout-agent-eval (Eval v4)
service-level — publishes_to · subject is the Service Card itself
v12 declares no Service-subject publication — stated as absent, not hidden.
▸ spec.yaml — 41 lines · validated wyrd/v1 · expand to view
expands inline without navigation · secret values never appear in any expansion
gate + invoke rules govern this Service
every ref keeps its own route: /t/acme/cards/{uid}
selecting v11 rescopes declaration and observations
Credential and secret values are never
part of the declaration or this view.

svg.text: S-03 — Service Definition route: /t/acme/cards/card_service_01?view=definition&version=v12 pattern: R-SVC (view=definition)
states: declaration-first — purpose, entry_point (deploy-image import, never imported by Wyrd), runtime-aliased components with versioned Card refs (two aliases → one capture-review Card),
publication bindings split by subject semantics (component-level: subject is the component's Card observed through checkout-api v12; service-level: subject is the Service itself — declared

absent for v12), principal bound on first deploy contact + composed Policy, server-managed metadata, server-derived relationships, immutable version list; raw typed spec closed by default behind a real ▸ disclosure
links: components/publication/policy/reaction → /t/acme/cards/{uid}; Copy YAML; versions rescope ?version=; subnav → ?view={overview,composition,definition}; no secret values anywhere
